title: Spectroscopic and photochemical evaluation of stereochemically biased 3′-substituted spiropyran photoswitches
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37370-37379
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07750D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Vojtěch Boháček, Tereza Erbenová, Jakub Dávid Malina, Marie Kloubcová, Michal Šmahel, Václav Eigner, Jiří Tůma
A library of 18 optically biased spiropyran photoswitches were synthesised and evaluated using NMR and UV-vis spectroscopy. A strategy for synthesis of optically active spiropyrans and a new purification method for such compounds are also reported.
